purpose: Non-admission discovery of four distinct reproducible Swiss crop-hail research assets (exposure, reported damage grids, radar hazard and model code); original file checks, data rights, dependence and scientific use remain open.

entries.name: Swiss 2021 crop exposure grids used in the 12-event hail study
entries.provider: Portmann, Schmid, Villiger, Bresch and Calanca / Zenodo / CLIMADA
entries.spatial_scope: Switzerland, agricultural crop exposure; not individual insured parcel boundaries or policy records
entries.temporal_scope: Reference exposure year 2021; published research version v1 in 2024
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Published gridded Swiss crop exposure for wheat, maize, barley, rapeseed and grapevine; exact files, grid geometry, units and land-use provenance to verify per asset
entries.note: The peer-reviewed NHESS crop-hail paper 10.5194/nhess-24-2541-2024 explicitly cites Zenodo 11064756 for gridded crop exposure and explains crop-density dependence of hail damage-footprint skill. This source is linked to the same 12-event research as the damage and hazard datasets below: never count the linked assets as independent validation samples. No insurance TIV, insured parcel membership, carrier allocation or crop policy terms established. The exact Zenodo release/file license, hashes, spatial reference, time alignment and crop-code mapping must be checked before source admission.

entries.name: Reported crop hail damage grids for 12 Swiss historical events
entries.provider: Portmann, Schmid, Villiger, Bresch and Calanca / Zenodo / CLIMADA
entries.spatial_scope: Switzerland; spatially aggregated reported damage related to 12 historical crop-hail events
entries.temporal_scope: Twelve study events used in the 2024 published analysis; exact event days and observation vintage pending original-asset review
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Published gridded reported crop-damage information; original insurer reports are not automatically public and are not interchangeable with these research grids
entries.note: The NHESS Portmann et al. 2024 article explicitly identifies Zenodo 11064767 as 'Reported hail damage for 12 hail events in Switzerland' and says gridded damage information is available. This is a candidate for footprint occurrence validation, not permission to distribute underlying insurer claims, loss amounts or identifiable records. Review the precise Zenodo license, anonymization/aggregation, per-event units and linkage to hazard and exposure before download, rehosting or use. The same insured source data were used to design/assess the published method, so no independent holdout is implied.

entries.name: Swiss radar hail-intensity grids for 12 historical events
entries.provider: Portmann, Schmid, Villiger, Bresch and Calanca / Zenodo / MeteoSwiss research context
entries.spatial_scope: Switzerland, 12 event footprints; not an annual nationwide stochastic event frequency catalogue
entries.temporal_scope: Twelve observed study hail events cited in the 2024 article; exact event timestamps pending file review
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Gridded radar Maximum Expected Severe Hail Size (MESHS) research event data; published method compares crop resolutions of 8 km and vineyard resolutions of 1 km
entries.note: The NHESS article cites Zenodo 11064781 as 'Radar data for 12 hail events in Switzerland'. MESHS is an inferred radar hail-size indicator, not direct point-measured hailstone size, a building-damage vulnerability function, or a stochastic event frequency. Review upstream MeteoSwiss rights separately from the paper license and Zenodo record; verify NetCDF/other format, CRS, cell size, units, nodata and event-year identity. No OEP/AEP or insurer loss calibration is warranted by 12 selected historical events.

entries.name: Open crop-hail damage-footprint study model and reproducibility code
entries.provider: Portmann, Schmid and Villiger / Zenodo / CLIMADA-project
entries.spatial_scope: Swiss crop-hail methodology; external geographic transfer and asset-class use unvalidated
entries.temporal_scope: Research code version 1.0 published 2024 alongside NHESS 24:2541-2558
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Python 3.9 study-specific model/reproduction code; dependency CLIMADA platform and public crop/radar/damage-grid research records
entries.note: NHESS 10.5194/nhess-24-2541-2024 provides DOI 10.5281/zenodo.12784190 for the published study code, as well as links to the three separately identified data assets in this shard. CLIMADA's cited platform license is GPL-3.0; do not assume the same license applies to all study code or linked third-party datasets. This is a hail crop-damage footprint classification research model, not an Oasis-ready insured loss model: pin archive checksum, code/dependency versions, valid tests and scientific limits before use.
